Intel: Kotlin package header emitted as Module and class name resolved via type_identifier fallback (#111, #112)

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"package foo.bar

class Widget {
    fun greet(): String = "hi"
}
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"language":"kotlin"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.language);
    println!("{:?}", result.structure);
    println!("{:?}", result.structure[0].kind);
    println!("{:?}", result.metrics.error_count);
}
```
